desc: With sounds and styles from the South Atlantic coasts, Caribbean, and the Andes on the Pacific, Chilean born composer Matias Urzua delivers this Latin Underscore album with music for scenes filled with tension, intrigue, suspense and drama.

tracks.desc: A dreamy Latin Underscore soundscape with a tinge of melancholy referencing Andean Folk. Featuring a traditional flute (quena) hailing from the regions of Bolivia, Chile, and Peru, this track also includes soft guitars, airy woodwinds and light charango (crelo guitar) evoking a floating feeling. Perfect for montages and time-lapses with a slow and pulsing rhythm, dialogue underscores, or for a calm, meditative, and scenic background that begs for a warm music bed.

A perfectly blended balance of light and dark moods. The first half of this Latin Underscore track has a cool, calm and collected Central American percussion rhythm. Features a laidback, moody bassline, a sandy shaker, bongo, and conga beat with soft circular nylon guitar phrasings. The second half has a lifted, strong, mystical vibe with a heavy low bass and a stoic electric guitar top-line with a tremolo effect. Perfect for moments of tension and release that help propel the story forward.

A dark, sneaky, and spooky tension track featuring a dissonant Cuban tres and nylon string guitar layered over a crooked latin percussion rhythm of congas, bongos and shakers. With uneasy and unexpected chord changes that give off a wobbly and unsettled vibe, this Latin Underscore piece is perfect for brooding moments. Also features vibraphone and glockenspeil for an added eccentric feeling, a touch of quirkiness and mystery.

A gloomy and brooding, dramatic Latin Underscore tension track pulling from Andean Folk and other Latin influences. Features an airy Andean quena flute, a melancholy nylon string guitar, and a moody Puertorican cuatro layered over suspenseful, cold pads and sound effects. Perfect for adding a moody and icy sense of drama to a story.

A slow and sensuous Latin Underscore track that features a singing nylon string guitar melody layered over a traditional Cuban cha-cha-cha rhythm played by the guiro, conga, and bongos. An elegant string countermelody makes this perfect for evoking a mix of drama, betrayal, corruption, sensuality, and class. Could also be used as a main title, motif, or montage music.

A dynamic and moody two-part Latin Underscore track that begins with an ominous, sparse atmosphere filled with tension and unease. The second half transitions into a danceable Latin salsa groove with the piano driving a rhythmic montuno, jazz drums locking into the beat, and the clave adding a steady pulse. The track retains its mysterious and suspenseful undertone, keeping the listener on edge.

A slick and stealthy samba groove carried by a laid-back upright bass and the warm tones of a Rhodes keyboard. Blending the intrigue of video-game soundtracks with the sophistication of Latin jazz, this Latin Underscore track showcases a crafty, muted electric guitar riff and the shimmering resonance of a vibraphone. The result is a seamless mix of tension and playful charm, creating a soundscape that feels both sly and cool.

A laid-back, rhythmically engaging Latin Underscore track driven by a smooth reggaeton beat and two Andalusian flamenco guitars in an intricate call-and-response pattern. The interplay between the guitars creates a mesmerizing dialogue, blending traditional Spanish flair with modern urban cool. The vibe is chill and sophisticated. Perfect for setting a relaxed yet dynamic atmosphere that feels both contemporary and timeless.

A haunting and atmospheric Latin Underscore track that begins delicately -- with sparse reverb-soaked notes from a Bolivian ronroco (creole guitar) -- creating a sense of introspection. Gradually the mood descends into a profoundly dark and cinematic soundscape. Brooding strings swell with intensity. A gritty metallic acoustic guitar takes center stage. Deep, rumbling pads add weight and tension. The result is a gripping blend of fragility and raw power, perfect for evoking drama and mystery.

A dynamic Latin Underscore track blending the bass-inspired drum textures of video-game soundtracks with Latin Jazz. Fast, chime-like cymbal patterns dance over an upright bass subtly hinting at a tumbao rhythm. A Rhodes keyboard anchors the sound with warm, velvety chords. Laid-back beginnings lead to a cool, improvisational jazz trumpet solo before escalating into an energetic burst of fast cymbals and vibrant Latin percussion, delivering a constantly shifting vibrant experience.
